_help: Edit this file, then run: cd design/tools && npm run teardown. null = 'measure pending'. Facts with verified:false come from secondary sources (ScreensDesign, TrustMRR, Stork, reviews) and are shown with a SECONDARY tag until you set verified:true after checking in the app yourself.

app.name: GoTall - Height Predictor
app.rating: 4.6 / 5 from 6.8K ratings (store); recent review feed is mostly 1-star

counts._help: From your stopwatch run, fresh install to the first screen that shows the height result / the paywall. Numbers or null.
counts.reportedFlowSource: ScreensDesign (secondary): 31 onboarding steps, paywall before the reveal

measured.note: Flow: promise, goal, about, height, parents, building, reveal (7 screens, 4 questions) then habits, plan, priming, paywall. Free result before the paywall. Source: design/measured-slice-spec.md sections 1-2 and 6. Taps are a design estimate until timed in the demo.

verdictFallback: GoTall needs about 31 steps and puts the paywall between the user and the answer. Measured gives the answer after 4 questions, free, and shows the full price.

placeholderFlow._help: Layout stand-in used only when a screenshot is missing. Types are inferred from ScreensDesign (secondary), not observed by us.

annotationsHelp: One object per screenshot file (01.png ...). type: promise|quiz|loading|paywall|result|other. friction:true draws a red badge with frictionNote. Missing entries fall back to the placeholder structure.

promise.benefitOrFeatureNote: Screen 1 not yet captured. Judge: does it promise an outcome (benefit) or describe the app (feature)? Store subtitle is '#1 height predictor & maxxer' (feature plus status claim).

darkPatterns: Result withheld until payment (bait and switch, per reviewers)
Price anchoring: $0.67/week hides the lump-sum yearly charge
Trial presented as a free subscription that auto-converts to a full year
Fear and status copy aimed at an audience that includes minors (age rating 9+)
paywall.measuredAnswer: Measured paywall: visible X, full price largest ($29.99 / year), trial end date and 'Today: $0', in-app cancel path, no countdown, and the result is already free.

reviews.sample: 150 reviews fetched via Apple RSS (us/gb/ca/au), 119 are 1-3 star. Keyword tallies overlap, approximate. Fetched 22 Oct 2026. Secondary source.

themes.theme: Result locked behind paywall after long quiz
themes.quote: I did the whole questionnaire and wanted to get my results but at the last second told me I had to pay (ca, 1 star)
themes.answer: Free result after 4 questions; the paywall only gates the plan.

themes.theme: Time wasted on long personal questionnaire
themes.quote: Tell me up front so that I don't waste my time. (us, 1 star)
themes.answer: '4 questions - about 60 seconds' on screen 1, a progress bar, the rest optional after the result.

themes.quote: It said $0.67 per week but it really charged me $35. (us, 1 star)
themes.answer: Full billed amount first, trial end date, 2-day reminder, cancel path shown.

themes.quote: I typed in a dream height of 185cm and the app says that the probability is very low. However the coach is predicting a height of 186cm. (au, 2 star)
themes.answer: One model, a range with stated error (+/-8.5 cm), method explained on the reveal.

themes.quote: Not fair how it asks me how tall my dad is when I've never met the guy (gb, 1 star)
themes.answer: 'I don't know' for each parent, the range widens and says so; no photo, no account.

themes.quote: What happened to the sleep score? It stopped going after week 13 (us, 3 star)
themes.answer: Small scope: a plan checklist that works; no referral or scoring promises.
